```yaml
name: Integration Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14, 16]
        package-manager: [yarn, npm]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.package-manager == 'yarn'
      uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
      with:
        working-directory: ./integration-tests
        useLockFile: true
        useRollingCache: true
        install-command: 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile'

    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.package-manager == 'npm'
      uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
      with:
        working-directory: ./integration-tests
        useLockFile: false
        useRollingCache: true
        install-command: 'npm install'

    - name: Run integration tests
      working-directory: ./integration-tests
      run: |
        cd fixtures/yarn-app
        yarn run test:integration
        cd ../npm-app
        npm run test:integration

    - name: Upload test results to GitHub
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: integration-test-results-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ matrix.package-manager }}
        path: ./integration-tests/results

    - name: Notify Slack about test results
      uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
      with:
        webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        status: ${{ job.status }}
        steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
        matrix: ${{ toJson(matrix) }}
        channel: '#ci-notifications'
        message: 'Integration test results for ${{ matrix.node-version }} using ${{ matrix.package-manager }}'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file named `integration-nightly.yml` is designed to run integration tests nightly for a repository containing Expo React Native projects. The workflow includes steps to set up the environment, install dependencies, run integration tests, upload results as artifacts, and notify a Slack channel about the test outcomes. The workflow is triggered daily at midnight UTC.

name: Integration Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14, 16]
        package-manager: [yarn, npm]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.package-manager == 'yarn'
      uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
      with:
        working-directory: ./integration-tests
        useLockFile: true
        useRollingCache: true
        install-command: 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile'

    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.package-manager == 'npm'
      uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
      with:
        working-directory: ./integration-tests
        useLockFile: false
        useRollingCache: true
        install-command: 'npm install'

    - name: Run integration tests
      working-directory: ./integration-tests
      run: |
        cd fixtures/yarn-app
        yarn run test:integration
        cd ../npm-app
        npm run test:integration

    - name: Upload test results to GitHub
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: integration-test-results-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ matrix.package-manager }}
        path: ./integration-tests/results

    - name: Notify Slack about test results
      uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
      with:
        webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        status: ${{ job.status }}
        steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
        matrix: ${{ toJson(matrix) }}
        channel: '#ci-notifications'
        message: 'Integration test results for ${{ matrix.node-version }} using ${{ matrix.package-manager }}'
